title: Baza CoopManage
description: Ibibazo ku nyandiko za koperative yawe, bisubizwa hakoreshejwe amakuru abitse.

field.question: Ikibazo cyawe
field.hint: Enter ibaza. Shift na Enter itangira umurongo mushya.

plainly.title: Baza mu magambo yoroshye
plainly.body: Uyu mufasha ahuza amagambo yo mu kibazo cyawe n'ibyo ashobora gushakisha. Ntiyumva ururimi nk'umuntu, bityo ikibazo kigufi kandi cyoroshye ni cyo kigenda neza — kandi ibyo ashobora kusubiza byose biri hasi.

empty.title: Baza ikibazo ku koperative yawe
empty.body: Igisubizo cyose kiva mu nyandiko za koperative yawe, hamwe n'imibare iri iruhande n'umurongo ujya ku paji ibyerekana byose. Nta kintu giteganywa.

refused.title: Nta kintu hano gisubiza icyo
refused.body: Uyu mufasha atanga gusa ibiri mu nyandiko za koperative yawe. Ntateganya, kandi ntashobora kugera ku bintu inshingano zawe ntizirimo. Urutonde ruri hasi ni ibyo ashobora kusubiza byose.

canAsk.title: Ibyo ushobora kubaza
canAsk.body: Uru rutonde ni rwawe: rurimo gusa ibyo inshingano zawe zikwemerera kureba. Hitamo kimwe ushyire mu kazu.
